title: Microsoft Teams: desk utilisation analytics in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, desk licensing conditions and documented governance controls are supported. It distinguishes the planned analytics from the existing preview report and explicitly reports Microsoft's conflicting licensing guidance rather than resolving it by assumption.

claims.claim: The script exports peripheral and account information in a PERIPHERALS file used for inventory import and association.
claims.quote: Provide the Account information so as to properly associate the peripheral with the right room or desk account. Provide the folder path where the PERIPHERALS.csv file will be saved when prompted.

claims.claim: The desk peripheral auto-association signal threshold is configured under Settings > General.
claims.quote: The threshold for how many signals it requires before associating is configurable on Teams Rooms Pro Management portal at Settings > General.

claims.quote: You can decide the right balance of association speed and accuracy for your organization, with a minimum of two unique signals and no maximum.
